content_sections.heading: DEO Korba Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the DEO Korba Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download DEO Korba Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DEO Korba Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Guest Teacher: Post graduation in the applied subject with minimum 60% marks, B.Ed from a recognized institution or university, and minimum 7 years of certified teaching experience as a PGT in a recognized school.

content_sections.text: Verification of documents Academic and experience marks evaluation Demo teaching Structured interview

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DEO Korba Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Office of the District Education Officer, Korba (Chhattisgarh) under the Disha Project for temporary teaching positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in DEO Korba Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available are Guest Teachers for various subjects including Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Hindi, and English.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for Guest Teacher positions across different subjects under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for DEO Korba Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The selection is conducted through a walk-in interview process which includes document verification, academic and experience evaluation, demo teaching, and a structured interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 10 October 2026, with registration starting from the morning hours at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000 per month based on actual work, attendance, and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduation degree in the relevant subject with a minimum of 60% marks, a B.Ed degree, and at least 7 years of PGT teaching experience in a recognized school.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to DEO Korba recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or submitting the application form.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview taking place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is at Sms (Hindi Medium) S.N.P.C.B. Korba, managed by the Office of the District Education Officer, Korba, Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a filled application form, passport-size photographs, ID proof, birth certificate, graduation and post-graduation marksheets, B.Ed degree, PGT experience certificates, and self-attested photocopies.
